snippet.title: Pac-Man World 2 Re-Pac - Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Content Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0700-PPSA18189_00-PM2REDLXEDITION0
 
Gotta Chomp Fast! The Hungry Hero and the Blue Blur are getting together in the Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set coming to PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC! This paid DLC content adds an entirely new island to Pac-Land featuring 3 all new Sonic-themed stages, 20 new figures to collect, a Sonic costume for Pac-Man, and an epic multi-phase battle with Dr. Eggman!
  
The Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set paid DLC for PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC is Available Now!
